submission.justification: R2 at 3 cm gives the highest simulated pi/K separation among the candidates not excluded by the earlier step (3.875 sigma). The thickness scan, including 2.5 and 3.5 cm, shows the peak at 3 cm. R3 has higher raw separation (4.661 sigma at 3 cm), but the earlier step excluded it pending lifetime data. No lifetime data is available for any candidate, so the lifetime constraint is not verified for R2 either. This recommendation carries that caveat, and lifetime/radiation-hardness data should be obtained before final adoption.

requirements.requirement: Best possible pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c
requirements.evidence: R2 at 3 cm gives 3.875 sigma, the best among non-excluded options. R3 reaches 4.661 sigma but was excluded pending lifetime data, so the best raw separation was not chosen.

requirements.requirement: Radiator is one of the three candidates
Radiator keeps performance over experiment lifetime
requirements.evidence: lifetime_data_available = 0. No lifetime data was recorded for any radiator, so this is unverified for R2. R3 was excluded by an earlier step pending that data.
3 cm is within the allowed range. The scan over 1-6 cm shows R2 peaks at 3 cm.
A single recommendation of R2 at 3 cm is submitted.
